Tool use: **run_terminal_cmd**

```bash
python3 - << 'PY'
import re, json, sys
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/Users/bietiekay/code/NavigationOverlayKit/Sources/NavigationOverlayKit/LocalizedManeuverTokens.swift')
src = p.read_text()

# Extract token arrays
pattern = re.compile(r"static let\s+(\w+)\s*=\s*\[(.*?)\]", re.S)
arrays = {}
for name, body in pattern.findall(src):
    # Extract strings in quotes
    tokens = re.findall(r'"(.*?)"', body)
    arrays[name] = tokens

# Normalize by lowercasing (file already lowercase except accents, but just to be safe)
arrays = {k: [t for t in v] for k,v in arrays.items()}  # keep as-is

# Duplicates within same list
within_dups = {}
for name, toks in arrays.items():
    seen = {}
    dups = set()
    for t in toks:
        if t in seen:
            dups.add(t)
        seen[t]=True
    if dups:
        within_dups[name] = sorted(dups)

# Exact duplicates across different lists
cross_exact = {}
names = list(arrays.keys())
for i,a in enumerate(names):
    for j in range(i+1,len(names)):
        b = names[j]
        sa = set(arrays[a])
        sb = set(arrays[b])
        inter = sa & sb
        if inter:
            cross_exact[(a,b)] = sorted(inter)

# Substring overlaps across different lists
cross_substrings = {}
for i,a in enumerate(names):
    for j in range(i+1,len(names)):
        b = names[j]
        subs = []
        for ta in arrays[a]:
            for tb in arrays[b]:
                if ta==tb:
                    continue
                if ta in tb or tb in ta:
                    # ignore trivial single-letter tokens (we don't have those) but keep short ones
                    subs.append((ta,tb))
        if subs:
            cross_substrings[(a,b)] = subs

print('WITHIN_DUPS:', json.dumps(within_dups, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
print('CROSS_EXACT:', {f"{a}|{b}":v for (a,b),v in cross_exact.items()})
# Limit substring output
limit = {}
for (a,b),pairs in cross_substrings.items():
    # filter to a few examples per pair for brevity
    limit[f"{a}|{b}"] = pairs[:20]
print('CROSS_SUBSTRINGS_SAMPLES:', json.dumps(limit, ensure_ascii=False)[:4000])
PY
```

Tool use: **run_terminal_cmd**

```bash
python3 - << 'PY'
import re, json
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/Users/bietiekay/code/NavigationOverlayKit/Sources/NavigationOverlayKit/LocalizedManeuverTokens.swift')
src = p.read_text()
pattern = re.compile(r"static let\s+(\w+)\s*=\s*\[(.*?)\]", re.S)
arrays = {}
for name, body in pattern.findall(src):
    tokens = re.findall(r'"(.*?)"', body)
    arrays[name] = tokens
within_dups = {}
for name, toks in arrays.items():
    seen = set()
    dups = set()
    for t in toks:
        if t in seen:
            dups.add(t)
        seen.add(t)
    if dups:
        within_dups[name] = sorted(dups)
# Exact duplicates across different lists
cross_exact = {}
names = list(arrays.keys())
for i,a in enumerate(names):
    for j in range(i+1,len(names)):
        b = names[j]
        sa = set(arrays[a])
        sb = set(arrays[b])
        inter = sa & sb
        if inter:
            cross_exact[(a,b)] = sorted(inter)
# Substring overlaps across different lists
cross_substrings = {}
for i,a in enumerate(names):
    for j in range(i+1,len(names)):
        b = names[j]
        subs = []
        for ta in arrays[a]:
            for tb in arrays[b]:
                if ta==tb:
                    continue
                if ta in tb or tb in ta:
                    subs.append((ta,tb))
        if subs:
            cross_substrings[(a,b)] = subs
print('WITHIN_DUPS:', json.dumps(within_dups, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
print('CROSS_EXACT:', {f"{a}|{b}":v for (a,b),v in cross_exact.items()})
limit = {}
for (a,b),pairs in cross_substrings.items():
    limit[f"{a}|{b}"] = pairs[:20]
print('CROSS_SUBSTRINGS_SAMPLES:', json.dumps(limit, ensure_ascii=False)[:4000])
PY
```
